jobs.description: As Austria's largest research and technology organisation for applied research, we are dedicated to make substantial contributions to solving the major challenges of our time, climate change and digitalisation. Our Center for Innovation Systems & Policy is a think tank in national and international research and innovation networks, and it is a key partner for public administration, companies, universities, and research institutions.The Com... 1 Master Thesis "Characterizing features of Driving Dynamics on a Motorcycle Probe Vehicle" - JOB ID: 269966  * For this master's thesis you will investigate extensive time series of driving dynamics obtained from multiple motorcycle rides by multiple riders on given tracks. * You will support us in working out characteristic features in driving dynamics that differentiate the different riders. * You will investigate the possibility of using simulation software (like IPG Motorcycle maker) to use the obtained data for setting up simulations of motorcycle movements. * Under the guidance of our researchers, you will implement model building approaches to extract characterizing features from motorcyclist data. * With the support of our team, you will investigate the feasibility of simulating driver movements based on the characterizing features extracted before. * You will explore different model-building approaches and criteria for selecting the most appropriate one with the guidance of our researchers.Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: * Ongoing master's studies in the field of Technical Mathematics at TU Vienna * Good knowledge in R, Python, or MATLAB, willingness to adopt multiple of these languages as needed * Enjoyment of application-oriented questions of industry * High level of commitment and team spirit * English or German skills commensurate with the role - The thesis can be completed in either language What to expect: * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months * Start date: as soon as possible, with some flexibility depending on your availability * EUR 1273 gross per month for 20 hours/week based on the collective agreement. * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).  At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants. jobs.occupation: Senior Staff Engineer Process Integration for Wide Bandgap Power Technologies (w/m/div)
jobs.description:
Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

We make life easier, safer and greener, with technology that achieves more, consumes less and is accessible to everyone. Microelectronics from Infineon is the key to a better future. Efficient use of energy, environmentally-friendly mobility and security in a connected world we solve some of the most critical challenges that our society faces while taking a conscientious approach to the use of natural resources. 1 Senior Staff Engineer Process Integration for Wide Bandgap Power Technologies (w/m/div) Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

 * Apply advanced statistical methods and AI applications to support technology stabilization, yield improvement, and cost optimization across the global process chain

 * Act as the Front-End representative for the development of WBG power technologies, collaborating closely with development and transfer teams

 * Drive and manage actions resulting from technology ramp-up activities following the official production release

 * Take full ownership of yield planning and ensure continuous yield monitoring to meet performance targets

 * Lead and participate in root cause analysis teams to define sustainable corrective and preventive actions for process deviations

 * Sustain and optimize high-volume production by contributing expert know-how on process and equipment capabilities in collaboration with global partner fabs

 * Execute release and delivery decisions for production goods in strict alignment with established quality and production standards

Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

 * A Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Data Science, or a comparable technical field

 * Several years of professional experience in semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on technology development, process, or yield engineering

 * Technical expertise in Silicon or WBG technologies (SiC/GaN) and experience supporting technology ramp-ups in high-volume environments

 * Advanced skills in statistical data analysis (SPC, DOE) and the application of AI/Machine Learning for process optimization

 * A structured and analytical mindset with a proven ability to drive complex topics independently from analysis to implementation

 * Excellent communication and interface skills to collaborate effectively across global production, quality, and development teams

 * Fluency in English is required, with German language skills being a distinct advantage in our international environment

We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.

jobs.occupation: Lab Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (all genders), Österreichische Rundfunksender GmbH (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: From DEV bench to center stage -- build the future of streaming.   At BIG BLUE MARBLE, we enable easy access to broadcast content in Austria while driving innovation and customer service in media delivery. Our mission is to actively shape the digital future of TV and radio. By continuously optimizing the media experience for our customers, we provide innovative streaming solutions while pursuing sustainable practices for a climate-friendly broadcasting landscape. To lead our Innovation & Research LAB -- publicly known as BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (labs.bigbluemarble.com) -- at ORS comm GmbH & Co KG, we are looking for a: Program Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs, all genders Are you a developer at heart who's ready for the next chapter -- one where you spend less time in the IDE and more time shaping which technologies your company bets on next? Do you want to turn prototypes into real business impact, represent your company on international stages, and build the innovation ecosystem of a streaming platform from the ground up? If you have a technical background and the ambition to grow into a coordinating, outward-facing leadership role, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs is where you belong. Your responsibilities:   Innovation  Scouting Innovation is not an end in itself for us. We want to understand early which technologies will shape the streaming world of tomorrow -- and which of them are actually relevant for our platform and our customers. You scout new technologies, solutions, start-ups, and trends in the streaming and media-tech space. You analyze technological developments and assess their relevance and potential applications for our products. You attend industry conferences, trade fairs, and events at home and abroad, build a relevant network, and bring fresh impulses into the company. You work closely with our Innovation Management and Professional Services team to move promising technologies from first assessment through to potential Proofs of Concept. You translate your findings into clear, digestible formats and share your knowledge internally and externally -- through technical blog posts, presentations, or trend and technology analyses. AI and automation are a permanent part of your technology radar -- always with an eye on concrete use cases in the streaming and platform environment. Innovation Lab & Proof of Concept Program You lead the operational activities of BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs and coordinate its day-to-day innovation processes. You organize and facilitate our bi-weekly Proof of Concept (PoC) sprints together with our Full Stack Development team. Together with Product Management, you evaluate ideas entering the innovation funnel, prioritize opportunities, and initiate new PoCs. You coordinate PoCs from idea validation to successful completion, ensuring transparency, alignment, and effective collaboration across technical and business teams. You make sure PoC outcomes are properly documented and turned into reusable knowledge, technical assets, or follow-up initiatives. You continuously improve our Lab processes, fostering an agile, execution-oriented innovation culture. Innovation Ecosystem & Strategic Partnerships You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs nationally and internationally within the innovation ecosystem -- universities, research institutions, public organizations, start-ups, and technology partners. You act as a key contact for strategic collaborations and help identify opportunities for joint innovation and research initiatives. You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE at conferences, workshops, exhibitions, and industry events, expanding our professional network and visibility. You contribute to strategic initiatives across the organization, supporting new partnerships and innovation opportunities. Knowledge Transfer & Innovation Communication You ensure innovation outcomes are communicated effectively, internally and externally. You support the creation of technical blogs, conference papers, exhibition contributions, presentations, and other dissemination formats. You prepare management-ready summaries, technology assessments, and recommendations based on PoC results and emerging technology trends. You promote knowledge sharing across teams and help translate innovation into long-term business value. Your background: A technical foundation, not necessarily a management CV. You have worked as a (Full Stack) Software Developer, Engineer, or in a comparable hands-on technical role -- and you understand modern software development, cloud technologies, and digital platforms from the inside. A Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a comparable technical discipline -- helpful for writing well-founded technical papers and conference contributions. Equivalent professional experience is welcome in place of a formal degree. A genuine wish to change direction: you're ready to trade day-to-day coding for coordinating people, representing the company externally, and shaping innovation strategy. Prior exposure to project or product coordination is a plus, not a requirement. Streaming and broadcast media know-how is very welcome -- but if you bring strong technical fundamentals, we're confident you can build this knowledge quickly on the job. You're comfortable presenting, networking, and representing BIG BLUE MARBLE confidently in front of external audiences -- at conferences, workshops, and partner meetings. You enjoy structuring ambiguous, early-stage ideas, coordinating people across disciplines, and turning promising concepts into tangible outcomes. Experience contributing to technical blogs, conference papers, white papers, or presentations is a strong asset. Comfortable working in agile environments and facilitating sprint-based collaboration. Experience with universities, research institutions, start-ups, or technology partners is a plus. Fluent English (C1/C2) and German (minimum B2) are required. What we're proposing for you: In addition to an annual salary in line with the market, we offer you a package of benefits consisting of a mobility allowance for the Wiener Linien annual ticket or the KLIMATICKET, a company canteen, our bonus programme, the pension fund and a sports programme. Place of work: Vienna (remote option), working hours: 38,5hours per week, reference number: OC1026CINSE, starting date: 10/2026. We are happy to offer professionals with relevant training and experience a gross annual salary in line with the market of between 56,000 and 72,000 euros (salary group 4, Telekom-KV, 38,5 h/week)*. Remote work Good communication and direct cooperation are very important to us. You can work from home, from the modern office or hybrid. In practice, this means that, according to your preferences, you will benefit from working remotely or from an office in Vienna with a great location and a cool atmosphere. We are happy to talk about the details in a meeting.  Travel This position includes occasional national and international business travel, with an expected travel commitment of up to four weeks per year, primarily for conferences, trade fairs, workshops, partner meetings, and industry events. *For legal reasons, we are required to state the minimum salary as per the collective agreement. For this position, it is  EUR 3.523,02 gross/month (Qualification Group 4, Specialist Level, Telekom collective agreement 2026, full-time).  Why join us: You're passionate about media technology and want your career to move from building things to shaping what gets built next. You bring a technical foundation, curiosity about streaming and broadcasting, and the communication skills to be a trusted voice -- internally and externally. Analytical thinking, the ability to navigate complex, ambiguous topics, and genuine enthusiasm for realization complete your profile. This is you?  Contact us via karriere.ors.at  We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and especially welcome individuals from underrepresented groups.
